title: Immunization Services Appointment Terms for Patients — Walk-ins, Booking Window and Slots
content:
These terms state, for each Immunization Services vaccination, whether a patient may receive a dose without an appointment, how far ahead and how close to the start of a slot an appointment may be booked, how long a slot lasts, how many appointments a course may hold open at once, and whether the next dose of a series is booked automatically.

## Schedule of appointment terms

| Vaccination | Dose without an appointment | Appointment required below age | Most days ahead of today | Open appointments per course | Slot length (minutes) | Same-day slot bookable until (minutes before start) | Next dose booked automatically | Automatic booking falls on (days after the dose given) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination | Yes | 18 | 30 | 1 | 10 | 30 | No | 0 |
| Seasonal Influenza High-Dose Vaccination | Yes | 0 (never) | 30 | 1 | 10 | 30 | No | 0 |
| COVID-19 Updated Vaccination | Yes | 18 | 30 | 1 | 15 | 30 | No | 0 |
| RSV Older Adult Vaccination | No | 0 (never) | 21 | 1 | 15 | 30 | No | 0 |
| Pneumococcal Conjugate Vaccination | Yes | 0 (never) | 30 | 1 | 15 | 30 | No | 0 |
| Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series | No | 0 (never) | 30 | 1 | 15 | 30 | Yes | 60 |
| Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series | No | 0 (never) | 30 | 1 | 15 | 30 | Yes | 30 |

## Terms explained

1. **Dose without an appointment.** Where the schedule shows Yes, a dose may be given without an appointment. The age in the next column is the age in whole years below which an appointment is required even so; 0 means never.
2. **Most days ahead of today.** An appointment is booked for a date no more than this many calendar days after today.
3. **Open appointments per course.** The most booked appointments a course may have open at once.
4. **Slot length.** Appointment slots run for this many minutes.
5. **Same-day slot.** A slot on the same day is bookable only until 30 minutes before it starts; after that point it can no longer be booked the same day.
6. **Automatic booking.** Where the schedule shows Yes, the next dose is booked automatically when a series dose is given, on the day that lies the stated number of calendar days after the dose just given.

## Hypothetical examples

- A hypothetical 15-year-old seeking the Seasonal Influenza Standard-Dose Vaccination is below 18, so an appointment is required although walk-ins are allowed for that vaccination; at 18 no appointment is required.
- For a hypothetical booking made today, an RSV Older Adult Vaccination appointment 21 days ahead is within the terms and one 22 days ahead is not; for the other vaccinations the figure is 30 days.
- A hypothetical Hepatitis B Three-Dose Series dose given on day 0 leads to an automatic booking on day 30; for the Recombinant Zoster Two-Dose Series the automatic booking falls on day 60.
